svg.title: Nieshetsienz Gas Giant Survey Vessel - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 108-109, PDF 109-110. Combined envelope follows larger Deck 1: long tapered nose, very broad straight trailing-edge aft delta wings and two rear drives. Smaller upper reaction-drive deck is contained. Illustration corroborates shuttle-like delta profile; vertical tail and underwing detail excluded.
